response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (15+ years) full-stack/backend engineer with strong general software craftsmanship, some high-scale systems work (e.g., Sociomantic's high-throughput microservices), and broad language versatility. However, his resume shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, A/B testing, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core domain of this Principal role. His career trajectory reflects lateral moves across varied domains (GIS, fintech, direct mail, dev tooling) rather than escalating ownership of cross-team platforms or experimentation systems, and there's no evidence of the multi-workstream technical leadership or statistical/experimental analysis expected at IC6.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across many languages and stacks
Demonstrated experience with high-scale, low-latency distributed systems (e.g., millions of requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and running workshops/talks showing strong craftsmanship culture
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, or rollout/risk-control systems
No evidence of telemetry/metrics platform work or statistical/experimental analysis skills
Career pattern shows lateral moves across unrelated domains rather than principal-level ownership of cross-team growth/measurement platforms

key_factors.factor: No telemetry/metrics or statistical analysis background
Strong general engineering breadth and scale experience
